items.html: Know that the upper Ima spreads through all the three worlds BYA: for her GAR are clothed in Beria, her VAK in Yetzira, and her Malchut in Assiya. And the secret of the matter is that Tvuna, which is clothed in ZA of Atzilut — behold, her entire Partzuf descends to illuminate in Beria in this manner: her GAR are clothed in the GAR of Beria, and these three are called the Throne (Kisse), mentioned in many places.
